features: THE HALF NOBODY HAD FIXED — This version touches the database: the number-of-rooms column changes from integer to decimal. It is a widening and no data is modified, but if some unit held an impossible number in that field (above 999,999) the update stops and says which one, instead of failing with a database error code. Four forum reports, and three had the same shape: something had already been fixed, but only where the person reporting it could see.

THE DOWNLOADED DOCUMENT NO LONGER LOSES ITS EXTENSION, FROM EITHER DOOR. An administrator reported it in May, attaching the fix as well: it was right and it was applied. In August the same thing came back from the resident's side, where files were still downloading without «.pdf». It was not a new defect: the two areas held two nearly identical copies of the same function, and in May only one of them had been fixed. From this version the naming rule lives in one place only, so it can no longer be fixed halfway. On Windows the difference shows, on macOS it does not — which is why the report took three months to arrive.

CLICKING AN ARCHIVE CATEGORY NO LONGER ERRORS, AND NOW DOES SOMETHING. The report read: «clicking on any of the categories I get the error Call to undefined method… honestly I don't even know what the software is supposed to do when you click a category». The second sentence was the right question: the category name was a link to a page that never existed, and it now leads to the documents in that category — which is what the product already does on the other side, where the resident browses the archive by category. The list that opens declares itself filtered and says what by: the name appears next to «Category» — «Minutes» — the filter does not vanish at the first touch of the search bar, and the button to clear it is right there.

SEVENTEEN ADDRESSES THAT ANSWERED «SERVER ERROR». The previous version closed nine of them, the one before that four, each time in the file where the defect had been seen. Counting them all there were seventeen, spread across five files: invitations, supplier contacts, archive categories, user-area documents. These are addresses the program registered without having the code behind them: anyone reaching them — a bookmark, an old link, a link in an email — got a server error instead of a page. All removed, and from today a new one cannot be created unnoticed. If you have a bookmark on one of those addresses you will now find «page not found» instead of an error: they are screens that never existed.

THE NUMBER OF ROOMS ACCEPTS HALF ROOMS, AND NOW SAYS SO WHEN IT REFUSES. The report read: «in some land registry records that value is not a whole number… it gives no error but it does not save the data». Two defects were stacked on top of each other. The first: the field only accepted whole numbers, so 6.5 would not go in. The second, worse: the error existed and had nowhere to appear. The unit's form checks sixteen fields and showed the outcome for four, so the program refused in silence — and not only the number of rooms: it saved nothing at all. Anyone correcting the floor, the surface area and the rooms together lost the other two corrections without knowing.

ROOMS NOW ACCEPT DECIMALS, quarter rooms included, written with a point or a comma: whoever types a comma is not corrected, it is straightened out on its own. And every field on the form has somewhere to show its error, including surface area, floor, notes and the five land registry identifiers. The surface area had the same defect and nobody had reported it: written the Italian way — 90,5 — it was refused in silence exactly like the rooms. Fixed together. One small annoyance disappears from the screen as well: square metres and rooms are no longer written with useless trailing zeros, «400 m²» and not «400.00 m²».

THE UNTRANSLATED BREADCRUMBS: ALREADY SORTED. The report concerned beta.50 and had already been fixed in beta.60, so whoever updates sees it sorted. Looking for any remaining case turned one up, in the name of whoever wrote a comment, where the technical key sometimes appeared instead of «Unknown user». Fixed.

THE ARCHIVE CARDS NOW SAY WHAT THEY ARE ABOUT. Above the document list there are four numbers, and they were titled «Total documents» and «Total space used». They were not totals: they counted only the archive, leaving out invoice attachments, property documents and supplier documents. Measured on a test archive: six documents on disk, the cards counted two; space used about 11 MB, the cards said 414 KB — and the disproportion is no accident, because the heavy files (floor plans, land registry records) live on the units and not in the archive. The exclusion from the list stays and has a reason: an invoice's attachment lives on the invoice. What changes are the labels, which now say what the numbers really count: «Documents in the archive», «Archive space». The real question — how much disk am I actually using, and where — has no answer yet and is a job of its own: an 11 MB total above a list showing two documents would confuse more than it does now. It is being worked on.

UNDER THE BONNET. Three links in the document emails led to a page that does not exist — two for the administrator, one for the resident, and the latter opened a server error: the address is now built from the page's name, which is verifiable, instead of being written by hand piece by piece. The management list did not paginate: changing page or sorting died in an error, because it called an address that never existed. The resident had a «create new category» panel that could not work — you pressed «Save» and nothing happened, without a message — and categories are managed by the administrator, so the panel was removed rather than repaired. The document archive was not testable because its page used a calculation function that only exists on MySQL. The documents disk is now declared explicitly in sixteen places where it used to be implied.

TWO NEW STRUCTURAL CHECKS freeze a family of defects this project had already fixed three times, case by case: no registered address may point at code that does not exist, and no screen may call an address that does not exist. At the moment they are written they report zero findings, which is the measure of a usable guard. A critical review carried out before release found seven defects with the suite green, two of them in code this very version had just written — including one that would have made the update fail on an installation with an out-of-size number of rooms. They are all fixed here.
